prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. First image is the edit target. Scale the ENTIRE group of dishes and food down to 75 percent of its present size, centered on this same cream tabletop. Complete plate rims must lie between x=200 and x=1336 on 1536-pixel canvas. Add plain cream tabletop around all sides. Preserve exact food counts and configuration; page 9 stays strictly overhead. No other changes.
CURRENT SCENE CONTRACT:
Use case: illustration-story. One finished landscape 3:2 full-bleed picture-book illustration, one coherent scene and moment, no panels or contact sheet. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
 No named child cast: Kit and Zoe MUST NOT appear. Include unnamed human workers/adults ONLY when explicitly required by this particular scene; otherwise show only the natural subjects. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: Fruit or Seed?; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: Close observational views on a cream tabletop and two clearly separate real plants in a garden. No characters, cutting tools or handling instructions. Exactly one tomato and one pea pod, opened for comparison in prepared stages.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): One ripe red tomato with green calyx; prepared halves show seeds in gel chambers; One pea pod containing exactly six green peas; Two cream dishes, left for tomato and right for pea pod; Natural tomato flower and pea flower shown only on their respective plants
 Input references lock identity, prop design and location; compose a NEW image for the exact scene, never reproduce the reference-board layout. The reference and overall prop list may contain finished objects and later story events: these are DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY, not permission to show them now. Show only the people, objects and development stage required below.
Page 10. Printed prose (NOT text to put in art): Both dishes hold fruit and seeds. The pod belongs with the tomato, even though its seeds look very different.
Required illustration: Final side-by-side whole-to-part arrangement: tomato halves left; opened pod, five inside peas and one loose pea right.
Exact current state: Classification closes with both fruits and their contained seeds, no arbitrary vegetable bin.
Do not add later events, duplicate props or a separate inset. No written title; the app renders live text.
